comment: Preview on canvas stands above the thumbnail so it stays under the pointer. At 1920 by 1080 and a UI scale of 1, a stroke is painted and Gaussian Blur opened at a radius of 30 with Preview on canvas on, as a fresh profile starts it, so the thumbnail is hidden. The pointer is moved onto the switch by its name and the line says where it aimed. The switch is clicked off where it stands, and the second shot shows it above the thumbnail and its Preview caption, which have come back under it. The pointer is aimed at the switch again and lands on the same point, then the switch is clicked on and the third shot shows it where it was with the thumbnail hidden again, and the aim says the same point a third time. The describe line after each click says where the switch stands.
